scope: Source-only CODE_REVIEW of the pending M5 analysis, plus read-only schema and pure CSV-helper checks on actual already completed M4 and baseline artifacts. The full M5 analyze function and CLI were not executed. No fictional completed trial, synthetic result fixture, SSH, CUDA, training or inference was used.

checks.evidence: The analysis requires controller COMPLETE with exactly the four expected variants, the completed text-intake status, 196 frozen cases, 882 enhanced state cases, 521262 repeated-condition query rows, paired sampling, all CPU audits, zero heldout and zero added parameters. It requires completed M4 analysis and baseline summary before reading all five historical references. Each new run must be COMPLETE/50 epochs and every mandatory phase exit must be zero. DeMo is excluded from enhanced diagnosis/state-head requirements.

checks.check: Matched parent settings and training evidence
checks.evidence: For every new variant, arguments must equal its real corresponding parent except output and the three graph flags. Dataset/MSVR310, seed42, variant, .1 graph weight, .07 temperature and exact seven-source reference cycle are required. Parameter counts, trainable counts, descriptor and split counts match the parent; the three enhanced models must share the same budget. Full1032/591/1055 counts, visited1032 with no unvisited records, successful/skipped AMP counts and batch log length are checked. Identity/batch/partial orders are compared exactly to each parent and across all four new runs. The script recomputes all49 graph-pair counts from each log, checks deterministic cycle and stopped distinct-positive audits and requires exact agreement with the controller.

checks.check: Six metrics and signed paired comparisons
checks.evidence: The imported helpers require591 ordered valid queries and matching GT identity/camera/scene/name/gallery fields before pairing. Six metrics are reconstructed from the per-query CSVs and checked against CPU audit values. Delta is consistently after minus before; harm, rescue, AP improved/worsened/unchanged counts and both-metrics-plus2 are retained. Eight intended comparisons cover all49 conditions, giving392 CSV rows, without filtering negative results. The CSV column slice begins after comparison, condition and six metric columns and includes every remaining declared field. Group memberships and sizes use the existing reviewed comparison_groups helper.

checks.check: Enhanced frozen states and head diagnostics
checks.evidence: For each enhanced model all six states and49 conditions are reread and all six metrics matched to the independent state audit. State11 rows must exactly equal the new model's frozen CSV rows. Three inference effects (11 minus00,10,01) are reconstructed and checked against saved signed metric and harm/rescue/AP counts. Public/private state metrics, all head summaries, all condition calibration values, three-dimensional means and comparisons against zero-prediction MAE remain in the report. This branch never fabricates DeMo state or calibration outputs.

Training result runtime and frozen extraction runtime are carried with their existing schemas. Per-phase wall time is separately computed from actual process exit.finished minus launch.started and requires positive time and exit0. The report states that selected-checkpoint extraction time is not training time, conditions reuse the same591 queries, condition means are descriptive, frozen00 is the same newly trained model with experts closed, and benchmark-selected single-seed MSVR results are not an untouched or three-dataset/multiseed success. goal_complete stays false.

The CLI requires explicit trial, prior and baseline roots and refuses an existing analysis.json. It performs only local JSON/CSV/JSONL reads and writes analysis.json plus the392-row comparison CSV. It has no neural imports or remote execution. Source parses with Python3.10 grammar. No task-unrelated model, training, collector or producer source was edited by this reviewer.

actual_existing_artifact_validation.details: load_bank was invoked only on the five actual historical frozen banks. Existing query_rows/summarize/compare/comparison_groups were applied to all three actual historical M4 state exports. Metric agreement, exact state11/frozen row equality, every signed effect count and three-component calibration schemas passed. Actual parent argument and runtime keys were inspected. These are checks of already completed historical evidence, not M5 results or a simulated complete M5 analysis.

pending_actual_M5_validation.required: After the real four-model campaign and reviewed intake complete, run this exact analyzer against the actual collected M5 directory and existing real parent roots. All completion, matching, coverage, CSV, signed-state and phase-exit assertions must pass before accepting any new numerical conclusions.
